# The map lister. It reads a loose map file and prints what the map contains, so it lives outside
# code/ and builds into tools-bin/ with the other tools. tables.inc is generated by gen_tables.py
# from the engine sources; the mapinfo-tables-current test fails when it is stale.

add_executable(mapinfo
    main.cpp
)
target_compile_features(mapinfo PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(mapinfo PRIVATE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/code")
set_target_properties(mapinfo PROPERTIES
    FOLDER "Tools"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tools-bin"
)
target_compile_options(mapinfo PRIVATE
    $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/MTd>>
    $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/MT>>
    $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/EHsc>
    $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/Zc:__cplusplus>
)
